title: bulbine australis
intro: Bulbine australis, commonly known as Red Hill or Orange Hill Bulbine, is a succulent plant species native to South Africa. The health benefits of Bulbine australis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as eczema, acne, and skin ulcers. Bioactive constituents of Bulbine australis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
